about.hero_title: A 30+ Year Passion for Woodworking & Timeless Craft
about.hero_desc: Discover Ghanem Furniture: our journey, our vision, and the core values that establish us as a premier authority in bespoke luxury woodwork.
about.story_title: From an Authentic Wood Workshop to an Integrated Industrial Milestone
about.story_p1: The story of Ghanem Furniture began more than three decades ago with a genuine passion for carpentry and artisanal craft. Over the years, we successfully merged this time-honored heritage with state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies.
about.story_p2: Today, we operate fully equipped workshops powered by modern Italian cutting machinery and hot-melt edge banding technology, delivering supreme accuracy for homeowners, designers, and contractors.
about.vision_desc: To remain the benchmark across the region for anyone seeking uncompromising luxury, durability, and craftsmanship in bespoke woodwork.
about.mission_desc: To deliver engineered wooden spaces of unparalleled aesthetics and structural integrity, crafted to elevate lifestyles and endure for generations.
about.values_title: The Guiding Principles Behind Every Piece We Build
about.val_1_desc: We select the highest-grade timbers, boards, and hardware to guarantee superior durability and flawless finishes.
about.val_2_desc: We adhere strictly to agreed delivery timelines, valuing our clients' commitments and peace of mind.
about.val_3_desc: Transparent pricing, comprehensive technical specs, and regular progress updates through every production stage.
about.val_4_desc: Embracing global design innovations, continuous shopfloor upgrades, and photorealistic 3D engineering software.

faq.hero_desc: Everything you need to know about our fabrication process, materials, delivery timelines, and services.
faq.q1: What types of wood and materials do you use in fabrication?
faq.a1: We utilize natural fine woods alongside high-grade boards including multi-layer blockboards and various HPL panels, coupled with certified hydraulic soft-close hardware and drawer runners for lifetime durability.
faq.q2: What is the typical manufacturing and delivery timeframe?
faq.a2: Standard manufacturing and delivery ranges from 1 to 2 months following final design approval, site survey, and down payment, with strict compliance to contractual deadlines.
faq.q3: Do you provide on-site inspection and dimension surveys?
faq.a3: Yes, our engineering team provides on-site visits and laser precision measurements to ensure the bespoke design matches the exact space dimensions.
faq.q4: Do you provide B2B cutting and edge-banding for workshops and designers?
faq.a4: Yes, we provide full B2B manufacturing support including Italian precision cutting, hot-melt edge banding, and pre-drilling at competitive volume rates.
faq.q5: How can I request a 3D design or project quotation?
faq.a5: You can reach us directly via phone or WhatsApp at 01000363618, or submit the 3D design request form on our website to have an engineer contact you immediately.
